_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47). Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 3.9% to $18,759; units grew faster (+16.1% to 1,372) and orders +11.8% to 1,080.
Metatarsal Pads (53% of sales) grew 5.6% to $10,002, led by the Small 6-pack (+57% to $1,420).
Scaphoid Pads (+33% to $1,480) and Long. Arch Pads (+27% to $998) grew; the Posting Heel Wedge fell 32% to $692.
refunds: Refund money was $751 vs $1,294 last week: 56 refunded units (from 86) and a 5.2% refund rate (from 8.9%).
pacing_reco: November is $58,575 through Nov 22 ($2,663 a day), pacing to about $79.9K vs $88,044 in October. The same 22 days last year were $12,513.
ads_context: Ad spend fell 7.7% to $2,072 but ad sales fell 29% to $3,948, so ACoS rose to 52.5% (from 40.4%). TACoS improved to 11.0% (from 12.4%).
Sponsored Brands ran at 73% ACoS ($401) and Sponsored Display at 143% ($68); SB video was the most efficient at 43%.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $2,113 on $890 (42.2% ACoS) and brought 113 orders.
Category keywords cost $717 for $922 in sales (77.8% ACoS); auto targeting ran at 51.3%.

Pause the Posting Heel Wedge auto campaign ($34, no sales) and the Metatarsal Bars SB video ($34, no sales).
